isolated_replay.ideal_timing_kind: sum of per-phase maxima of independent-role median samples
isolated_replay.timing_boundary: Resident secret inputs/model through every intermediate and final MAC check; native preprocessing and private sharing excluded

clear_baselines.model: actual trained Linear(16,64), square, Linear(64,8) in PyTorch inference mode

measurement: Four real processes over localhost mutual TLS; shared GPU and OS account. Live inference includes first-use compilation and optional transcript recording; it is not a steady-state or ideal-network estimate. Optional isolated_replay serializes each role after a completion barrier and reports separate perfect-network estimates.
provisioning: Each worker consumes only its own native role bundle. No coordinator reads private preprocessing. Deployment needs separate security domains.
privacy_audit_failure: Small-field MAMA can accept a correct authenticated correlation whose mask is known to malicious parties with probability about 1/p. Functional outputs and timings remain evidence only; see docs/native-mama-sacrifice.md#mask-privacy-limitation.
